💡 The novelty lies in simultaneously enhancing Co3+/4+ redox while suppressing O redox by amplifying Co t2g and reducing O 2p density of states, breaking the capacity–stability trade-off. This yields 212.1 mAh g–1 at 4.6 V with 88.4% retention over 330 cycles, mitigating phase transitions, O loss, and parasitic reactions—offering a valuable electronic-structure engineering strategy for high-voltage LiCoO2 cathodes.

هم‌افزایی هم‌حلال قوی-ضعیف (DMSO/DMC) در الکترولیت آبی روی، سد انتقال بار را حدود ۴۰ درصد کاهش داده و پایداری ترمودینامیکی و سینتیک دسولواتاسیون را هم‌زمان بهبود می‌دهد.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in pairing a strong cosolvent (DMSO) with a weak one (DMC) to spatially decouple solvation-shell stabilization from outer-shell buffering, yielding nonlinear kinetic optimization absent in single-cosolvent systems. Significance: ~40% lower charge-transfer barrier, regulated SEI, and preserved thermodynamic stability, establishing strong–weak cosolvent synergy as a design principle for practical aqueous Zn batteries.
🏷 aqueous zinc battery · cosolvent electrolyte · desolvation kinetics · solid electrolyte interphase · Zn2+ charge transfer

item.title: Competitive Solvation Structure in a Deep Eutectic Electrolyte Enables High‐Voltage LiCoO 2 ‐Based Pouch Cells With 5000‐Cycle Stability
item.description:
الکترولیت اوتکتیک عمیق با ساختار حل‌پوشی رقابتی و نمک دوگانه، پایداری ۵۰۰۰ چرخه‌ای و چگالی انرژی ۴۱۷ وات‌ساعت بر کیلوگرم را در پاکت‌سل‌های LiCoO2 فراهم می‌کند.
Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a deep eutectic electrolyte using succinonitrile and dimethyl sulfone with competitive coordination, shifting Li+ solvation from aggregates to balanced AGG/CIP distribution. This lowers desolvation barriers while enabling anion-rich interphases. Significance: 3.87 mS cm−1 conductivity, 0.81 transference number, 6800 h cycling, 417 Wh kg−1 pouch cells, and 5000-cycle stability—harmonizing fast-charging kinetics with high-voltage interfacial robustness.
🏷 deep eutectic electrolyte · LiCoO2 pouch cell · solvation structure · solid electrolyte interphase · high-voltage lithium battery

item.title: Rate Capability of Lithium‐Rich Manganese‐Based Oxide Cathodes: Charge–Discharge Kinetics, Multiscale Bottlenecks, and Dynamic Rate‐Determining Steps
item.description:
این مرور، موانع نرخ‌پذیری کاتدهای اکسید منگنز غنی از لیتیوم را در سه سطح انتقال بار، کندی ردوکس آنیونی و تخریب ساختاری تحلیل کرده و جابه‌جایی مرحله تعیین‌کننده نرخ را بررسی می‌کند.
Advanced Materials | ⭐ Review
💡 This review uniquely deconstructs LRMO rate limits across three levels—charge transport, anionic redox kinetics, and degradation cascades—revealing that the rate-determining step shifts from electron transfer to ion diffusion, governed by j0 and jd. It highlights the overlooked charging bottleneck from asymmetric anionic redox and critiques cross-study C-rate comparability, providing a theoretical foundation for rational high-rate cathode design.
